name: pmc
description: Language support for .pmc via pmt lsp: diagnostics, completions, navigation, formatting, semantic tokens.

pmt.lint.allow.description: Lint codes to allow (merged by union with pmt.json).

run.description: Run the target after building; `build` only.

target.description: Target-mode launch: a target name from the pmt.json project manifest. Built in process (the same driver `pmt build TARGET` uses) with debug info forced on regardless of the target's own profile. Mutually exclusive with `program`.

project.description: Target mode only: where to start the pmt.json discovery walk (its own nearest-ancestor default otherwise — normally the workspace root).

program.description: Program-mode launch: path to a prebuilt .pmx executable, used as-is. Mutually exclusive with `target`. Build it with `pmt compile -g`/`pmt link` (or `pmt build --debug`) first — without debug info, source breakpoints answer unverified and default-granularity stepping only stops at function boundaries (request granularity: "instruction" to step one instruction at a time regardless).

tape.description: Program mode only: path to a .pmt tape snapshot. Omit for the empty tape.

strictCells.description: Program mode only: wrap the tape in the strict-cells decorator (same semantics as `pmt run --strict-cells`).

stopOnEntry.description: Break before the first instruction runs, instead of running to the first breakpoint (or to completion).

trace.description: Stream a per-instruction trace line to the Debug Console as console-category output, matching `pmt run --trace`.

configurationSnippets.label: pmt: Launch target
configurationSnippets.description: Build and debug a pmt.json manifest target in process.

configurationSnippets.label: pmt: Launch program
configurationSnippets.description: Debug a prebuilt .pmx executable against a tape snapshot.

scripts.compile: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle
